svg.title: Slovakia study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Little Carpathians near Modra; 2: Nitra; 3: South Slovakia near Štúrovo; 4: Central Slovakia near Veľký Krtíš; 5: East Slovakia near Sobrance; 6: Slovak Tokaj near Malá Tŕňa; 7: Bratislava; 8: Košice; 9: Prešov; 10: Žilina; 11: Zvolen

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.

choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
